title: On the line sportfishing
specs: Target species include Mahi Mahi, Wahoo, Sailfish, King Mackerel, Blackfin Tuna, Yellowtail Snapper, Mutton Snapper, Groupers, Porgy, Hammerhead, Bull and Tiger Sharks, Goliath Grouper, Amberjacks, Snook, Tarpon, and Spanish Mackerel
